Anyone can apply to own a Point, Center, Hub, or Command franchise. An application is reviewed by Zyngram admin staff before being approved - not every Point/Center/Hub/Command has an owner at all times; some remain intentionally unassigned until a suitable applicant is approved.

If a recharge order fails after the amount is deducted, Zyngram automatically reverses the payment to your original payment method within 2 to 5 business days.
